description: Spec §8.3: a spawned BP_DFScatter given SM_DF_Rock01, three transforms and bBlocking false, then RebuildInstances (what its construction script runs; a deferred spawn cannot be generated), has 3 instances of SM_DF_Rock01, NoCollision, culled at 30000 cm. Rebuilt with bBlocking true it still has 3 (the old ones are cleared) and collides (BlockAll).
